chunks.rationale: Start with test/appWiring.test.tsx 'failure path shows Failed to remove toast' — that is the measured bug. The fake still rejects with 'Cannot remove a project while a run is active'; the toast at [data-toast=error] must now include that reason after the slug prefix. Then test/sidebar.test.tsx: the existing confirm test now asserts the checkout is not deleted and that 'worktree' is absent when no thread has worktreePath; the new tests pin plural (2, ignoring another project's worktree) and singular wording.
risks: appWiring boots the real App; a leftover setRemoveFailSlug call crashed the whole file via ErrorBoundary on the first pass. Grep the rename both ways before merging.
Confirm copy is matched as a substring of textContent. JSX wrapping of the worktree sentence must keep a single space between 'including' and 'any' or the plural/singular tests fail.

chunks.rationale: src/App.tsx handleRemoveProject is the swallow. catch now reads err.message, stores Failed to remove "slug": <reason> (prefix alone if the message is empty), and still rethrows so Sidebar's confirm finally-closes. State is removeFailMessage, not a slug; archive/clear-settled still clear it so the two toasts cannot stack. The error variant of ArchiveToast is reused — title is the whole string.
risks: A main-process message that already starts with Failed to remove would double-prefix. useCoder rethrows the IPC Error as-is, so today's reasons (active run, leftover worktree) do not.
Long git stderr from the parallel electron worker will dump into a single toast line. No truncation here; do not invent a body slot on ArchiveToast.
Renderer-only: this does not make remove succeed. Without the electron worker, the toast now tells the user why instead of a bare slug.

chunks.rationale: src/components/Sidebar.tsx confirm counts threads with worktreePath in the same project as the dialog. Non-zero adds 'Deletes N worktree(s) from disk, including any uncommitted changes in them.' The old 'This removes only this project entry.' line is replaced with 'The repository checkout itself is not deleted.' — worktrees go, the checkout does not.
risks: Count is the live ThreadInfo.worktreePath list, not a disk scan. pendingWorktree threads (no path yet) are omitted, which is correct: nothing is on disk. Stale paths still count; the electron worker force-removes those.

Copy promises worktree deletion. If this renderer lands before the electron half of #613, the confirm would over-claim and the toast would then show THREAD_STILL_HAS_WORKTREE. Merge both halves together.
worktreePath on a thread in another project is ignored; the tests pin that.
Did not verify in a live Electron window — renderer tests + tsc only. The live failure is an IPC reject; the toast path is covered by appWiring with fail: projects.remove.
electron/ is owned by a parallel worker. Do not expect this branch to make Remove project succeed on the live store.
Issue #613 stays open (plan:doing) until the electron half lands.
Not verified in a live Electron window — electron tests only. Removing a project with archived worktrees on the running app is the real check.

npm run test:electron in this worktree is 1645/1645 pass once core/dist and memory-server/node_modules are symlinked from the main checkout. Without those links the suite reports hundreds of MODULE_NOT_FOUND / orch-server port-null failures that are not this change.
